description: On the yellow tabletop there’s a small metal pan with a handle near the back left, a bunch of red grapes in the middle, and a dark round plate on the right. The left hand reaches in from the right, pinches and lifts a small blue block from inside the metal pan, carries it rightward over the grapes, and lowers it onto the dark round plate, making the blue block a left-hand object until it is released.
